_comment: SideStep's anti-piracy blocklist. SideStep REFUSES to add these sources or install these exact known files, and ASKS FOR CONFIRMATION before sideloading a known PAID App Store app (so a legitimate owner can still proceed). Hand-curated — send a PR to add entries. MATCHING: 'sources' match by host (a host dedicated to piracy) or host + pathContains (a pirate manifest living on a host that ALSO serves legit apps — we block only that path). 'paidBundleIds' are REAL App Store bundle IDs of PAID apps, where a sideloaded copy is almost always piracy, so we warn (not hard-block, so owners can proceed). Free-app tweaks (YouTube++/Instagram++/etc.) are deliberately NOT listed here — their bundle IDs belong to free apps, so matching them would false-positive on legit installs; those are caught at the source level instead. 'ipaSha256'/'binarySha256' are exact known cracked files (zero false positives) — binarySha256 is the SHA-256 of the app's main Mach-O executable (survives re-zipping).

sources.note: CyPwn IPA Library — cracked/tweaked App Store apps (Spotify crack, cracked paid games)
WuXu's Library++ — ++/cracked apps. (The base wuxu-complete.json is jailbreak tools/emulators and is NOT blocked.)
Quantum Source++ — tweaked/cracked apps. (The base Quantum Source is legit and is NOT blocked.)
